hints.content:
The measure of an arc is equal to the measure of the [[☃ definition 1]] that intercepts it.

The arc measure of $\stackrel{\large{\frown}}{DE}$ is the measure of $\angle DPE$. We need to find the measure of  $\angle DPE$.


[[☃ image 1]]

options.definition: A central angle is an angle whose vertex is on the center of the circle.

options.alt: A circle that is centered around point P. Points A, B, C, D, and E all lie on this circle in a clockwise direction. Line segments A C and B E are diameters. Line segments A P, B P, C P, D P, and E P are radii of the circle. The angle A P E is a four W plus four degree angle. Angle A P B is a four W plus eight degree angle. The angle C P D is a two W plus eleven degree angle. Arc D E is highlighted.

hints.content:
From the diagram, we see that $\angle APE$ and $\angle APB$ are supplementary.  The measures of supplementary angles add up to $180^\circ$.  Thus:

$\begin{align}
m\angle APE + m\angle APB&=180
\\\\
(4w+4) + (4w+8)  &= 180
\\\\
8w+12 &= 180
\\\\
8w &= 168
\\\\
w &= 21
\end{align}$.

The measures of $\angle APB$ and $\angle EPC$ are congruent because they are vertical angles.  So:

$\begin{align}
m\angle APB &= m\angle EPC
\\\\
4w+8 &= 2w+11 + m\angle DPE
\\\\
4(21)+8 &= 2(21)+11 + m\angle DPE
\\\\
92 &= 53 + m\angle DPE
\\\\
39&= m\angle DPE
\end{align}$
